summary: Cheatsheet examples for installing a role with `ansible-galaxy role install` (which extracts to ~/.ansible/roles by default) and listing installed roles.
questions: How do I install a role from Galaxy?
Where does ansible-galaxy put roles it installs?
How can I list the roles installed on my machine?

answer_card.title: Install and list roles with ansible-galaxy
answer_card.answer_md:
- Install: `ansible-galaxy role install example.role` (the example extracts it to `~/.ansible/roles/example.role`).
- List: `ansible-galaxy role list`
